scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && python3 scripts/dotnet.py build MoovitDeCria.slnx -c Release
scripts.test: python3 scripts/dotnet.py build MoovitDeCria.slnx && python3 scripts/dotnet.py test --solution MoovitDeCria.slnx --no-build && npm run test:web && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/index.html scripts/*.mjs README.md docs .github/workflows
